# Decap CMS 3.18.0

Self-hosted official `decap-cms@3.18.0` distribution, MIT licensed.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/decap-cms/3.18.0

The npm tarball was verified against its registry SHA-512 integrity before extraction. Keep `decap-cms.js`, all `*.decap-cms.js` lazy chunks, WASM assets, `cms.css`, and license files together. Source maps and duplicate legacy `cms.js` bundles are omitted. `LICENSE` is from the matching upstream Git tag `decap-cms@3.18.0`; `decap-cms.js.LICENSE.txt` contains bundled third-party notices.

To update, download and verify a specific official npm version, replace this distribution as a set, and test editor loading, local saves, uploads, and GitHub OAuth before release. No CDN is used at runtime.
